newsitem.title: USA: Intl Business Systems seeks to offer ADS.
newsitem.headline: Intl Business Systems seeks to offer ADS.

text.p: International Business Systems filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of American Depositary Shares.

The Swedish public limited liability company said 6,636,055 Class B Ordinary shares are being offered in the United States and Canada in the form of ADSs each representing one B share, and outside the U.S. and Canada in either B shares or ADS.
Of the total offer, four million Class B shares are being sold by the company and 2,636,055 B shares are being sold by certain shareholders.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 15,121,020 B shares.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 900,000 additional B shares. The offering will be made through Credit Suisse First Boston, Robertson, Stephens & Co and Enskilda Securities.

The company said it will use the net proceeds for the repayment of certain debt, for the expansion of its sales, service and marketing organization and for general corporate purposes, including working capital.
The company has applied to Nasdaq to trade under the stock symbol IBSBY.O.

IBS, based in Solna, Sweden, is a provider of client/server enterprise resource planning solutions for managing the distribution, manufacturing, logistics and financial operations of distribution and manufacturing companies worldwide.
